title: Mahi Binebine's 'You and Me' Inaugurated at Bab Atlas — Marrakech Gets a New Landmark
body:
Marrakech welcomed a new monumental public artwork as Mahi Binebine unveiled 'You and Me' at the Bab Atlas roundabout. The ceremony was attended by the Wali of Marrakech-Safi and several hundred members of the public.

The Sculpture

'You and Me' depicts two figures in a posture of mutual recognition. Binebine described it as a meditation on human connection. The work sits at one of the city's busiest intersections, giving it daily exposure to approximately 80,000 vehicles.

Source: MadeInCity Marrakech. Reporting from the inauguration ceremony.
